svg.aria-label: How to write త: one unbroken stroke · 8 movements
svg.title: Writing త
svg.desc: 8 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of త (telugu), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansTelugu-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Sathish Shanmugam, Write Telugu Alphabets, consonant త packaged tracing guides res/drawable/dot_stroke_c_4_1_ta.png and res/drawable/line_stroke_c_4_1_ta.png, movements 1–7 (version 2.6) <https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sathishshanmugam.writetelugualphabets>. Source note on variation: The packaged tracing guide numbers six movements around the paired bowls and lower body, followed by a seventh for the top flourish. Those numbers mark movements, not pen lifts: the lift count follows HP Labs India's isolated handwritten Telugu character data (hpl-telugu-iso-char, https://lipitk.sourceforge.net/datasets/teluguchardata.htm), counted from the native-writer prototypes in the MIT-licensed LipiTk 4.0 Telugu recognizer. Those counts say how many strokes writers use, not where they break, so the single run keeps the guide's order. The centre lines are fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Telugu outline. Noto closes the left curl into a loop whose base meets the outer bowl, so movement 1 starts at that meeting point and runs along the base before curling up. It closes the right curl into a loop joined to the outer right side, so movement 6 climbs back up that side before curving left over the upper shoulder. Noto also joins the flourish to that shoulder, so the run climbs back up the flourish's left arm before curling through it; that climb is a new segment, so the filmstrip shows one more frame than the guide has movements.
svg.text: How it is written — one unbroken stroke · 8 movements
Stroke order after Sathish Shanmugam, Write Telugu Alphabets, consonant త packaged tracing guides res/drawable/dot_stroke_c_4_1_ta.png and res/drawable/line_stroke_c_4_1_ta.png,
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
